About the Team

Global Finance Operations & Transformation (GFO&T) is the division responsible for accounting
and reporting of accurate and consistent financial information for global Swiss Re for external
reporting and internal analysis facilitating strategic decision-making. This includes IFRS

for Global as well as statutory financial information for all Swiss Re's legal entities, including SST
and Solvency 2. GFO&T spearheads the transformation of Global Finance, streamlining it towards
a simpler, more effective, forward-looking organisation. The GFO&T Strategy & Transformation
Office is in charge of defining and aligning the GFO&T strategy in close alignment with the
leadership team and driving the Finance transformation on the divisional level, while delivering
high-quality senior stakeholder reporting and managing the divisional budget.

Senior Business Transformation Manager
About Us
BearingPoint is an independent management and technology consultancy with European roots. Our
global network spans over 70 countries and 13,000 people, working across Consulting, Products,
and Capital business units.
We work closely with clients to co-create and deliver meaningful transformation. From shaping
future operating models to supporting programme mobilisation, our teams combine strategy, design,
change, and delivery to help organisations grow, improve experiences for customers and colleagues,
and achieve lasting impact.

Who We Work With
Our clients span all sectors and sizes—from Irish SMEs to global multinationals, domestic and
international banks, investment firms, and major government departments. We value long-term
relationships and collaborative partnerships that support inclusive and sustainable change.

The Opportunity
As a Senior Business Transformation Manager, you will guide private-sector organisations through
complex, enterprise-wide change. You’! work at the intersection of strategy and implementation,
helping clients shape future operating models, co-design transformation roadmaps, and foster
performance improvement that lasts.
Youll build trusted relationships with senior leaders, supporting them through organisational
change, process improvement, and digital enablement. Your approach will be grounded in empathy,
collaboration, and a commitment to helping teams navigate change with confidence.

e Translate corporate strategy into actionable operating models and transformation
roadmaps.
e Engage stakeholders across Finance, Operations, Technology, and HR to encourage
shared ownership and adoption.
¢ Contribute to business development through proposals, thought leadership, and client
engagement activities.

To enhance our Operational Excellence department at our Vienna site, we are seeking a dedicated Corporate
Operational Excellence Implementation & Training Lead (m/f/d) to start as soon as possible on a full-time basis.
In this role you will be responsible for driving operational excellence initiatives worldwide by implementing bestin-class practices, building capability through training, and embedding a culture of continuous improvement. You
will ensure alignment with global strategy, deliver measurable business impact through Lean Six Sigma and
digital tools, and partner with stakeholders across regions to sustain performance and accelerate
transformation.

Your responsibilities
· Lead and manage AGRANA's Operational Excellence and Digitalization program, ensuring alignment
with strategic deployment.

· Design, implement, and sustain the Performance Management System / Management Operating
System (MOS) to enable consistent reviews, accountability, and leadership engagement after
benchmarking with AGRANA's current tools (SIMPAC).

 · Track and report Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) and performance measures (leading and lagging
indicators) across all AGRANA divisions.

· Collaborate with IT to develop and maintain interactive dashboards (e.g., Power BI) for data

collection, visualization, and actionable insights.
· Collaborate with global stakeholders, consultants, and cross-functional teams to strengthen

operational excellence practices
· Facilitate workshops, training, and coaching sessions to embed a culture of continuous
improvement.

· Apply Lean Six Sigma, problem-solving, RCA, FMEA, and other methodologies to deliver measurable
improvements.

· Review monthly performance to ensure process improvement projects deliver projected benefits.
· Standardize support processes and documentation to ensure sustainability.
· Support the design and rollout of global standards and best practices in performance management.
· Partner with HR to develop structured training programs and build internal capability.
· Drive adoption of digital tools and analytics to enhance performance visibility and decision-making.
Your profile
. Completed higher education, e.g., degree in Engineering or Business Administration, ideally with 8-10
years of relevant professional experience.
. Certified/trained Lean Six Sigma Black Belt or Master Black Belt.

· Extensive experience in Continuous Improvement within Manufacturing (preferably Food industry).
· Knowledge of financial reporting, budgeting, and performance analysis.
· Strong analytical, problem-solving, and facilitation skills.
· Expertise in Power BI (DAX, data modeling, visualization) and strong data-driven decision-making
abilities.

. Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey insights effectively.

· Fluency in English, both written and spoken; German preferred.

· Excellent occupational and personal development perspectives within an international group with
headquarters in Austria

· Diversified and interesting tasks in a dynamic team

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelez International?

Join our Mission to Lead the Future of Snacking. Make It Uniquely Yours.
As Director Planning Transformation, you will lead the transformation of our planning processes across Europe,
with a focus on deploying 09, a next-generation digital platform, leveraging Al/ML technologies, and unlocking
the full value of enterprise data. This is a senior leadership role where you will partner closely with regional and
global supply chain, MDS (IT), commercial and data teams to build best-in-class digital capabilities that drive
better service, agility, and cost performance.
As a strategic thinker who challenges non-value-added activities, you challenge cross-functional teams to
identify and improve processes and to prevent repeated losses that hinder us from achieving our goals. You help
us recognize business improvement opportunities, lead initiatives, and deliver results using the tools and
techniques associated with continuous improvement.

This a fixed-term 2-year contract role.
How you will contribute
You will:

. Lead the end-to-end digital transformation of planning processes in the E2E supply chain, from
demand forecasting to supply, inventory, and IBP.
. Lead the implementation and scaling of the 09 advanced planning solution, fully integrated with our
global ERP and data platforms.
· Drive innovation in planning through AI/ML-enabled forecasting, demand sensing, autonomous
planning, and scenario modeling.

 · Collaborate with data, IT, and business teams to develop a strong data foundation and real-time
analytics capabilities.

. Define the digital roadmap for supply chain planning and lead cross-functional execution across
Europe.
· Serve as a change agent and digital champion across the organization, driving adoption and

capability building.
· Build and manage a high-performing team of solution owners, data engineers, and transformation
leads.
· Ensure that capabilities and processes are deployed effectively and users have a great experience
· Redesign non-added value work processes, making sure individuals are fully capable of managing
new processes in their daily routines
What you will bring
A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career and the following experience and knowledge:
· Advanced Planning Tool Implementation: Hands-on experience with 09 implementation preferred.
Alternatively experience with Kinaxis, SAP IBP, or similar; leading global rollouts.
· AI/ML in Planning: Examples of AI/ML use (demand sensing, forecasting, segmentation); familiarity
with MLOps environments.

· Digital Transformation Leadership: Has led end-to-end transformation across people, process, tech;
worked in large, matrixed organizations.
· Data & Analytics Acumen: Understands enterprise data architecture, governance, data lakes, and
integration with planning tools.
. CPG Industry Planning Experience: Knows CPG dynamics: short shelf life, promo-driven demand,
multi-market complexity.

· Stakeholder & Change Management: Ability to influence senior leaders, manage change, drive
adoption in cross-functional teams.
· Cultural Fit: Experience working across Europe; multilingual or culturally adaptive.
. 10+ years of experience in supply chain, digital transformation, or planning systems leadership roles
in the CPG industry.

· Bachelor's degree required; Master's or MBA preferred.
· Fluent in English. Additional European languages are a plus.

As a Finance Transformation & Enterprise Performance Management Senior Manager in the CFO
& Enterprise Value team of Accenture Strategy & Consulting, you will manage a wide variety of
projects that are on and related to the agenda of the Chief Financial Officers (CFOs). The Finance
Transformation & Enterprise Performance Management team operates at the intersection of
Strategy, Process, Data, and Technology. As a Senior Manager, you will drive Finance business
advisory through end-to-end project delivery, which means that you will be involved in all stages of
a project, from strategy to implementation. You play a key role in business development and
relationship management with our clients across various industries, focusing on Finance Strategy,
Digital Finance Transformation, Enterprise Planning & Analytics, Environmental, Social, and
Governance (ESG), and Generative Artificial Intelligence (Gen AI) amongst others.

As a Senior Manager, you will contribute beyond client advisory and project delivery to also focus
on sales, using thought leadership to co-create, shape and sell new offerings to our clients. You will
leverage your proven, existing, and extensive external network to achieve the growth ambitions of
your service line.

organizations by bringing expertise, best practices, and strategic insights to our clients.

Group Transformation Manager
About Barilla
At Barilla, we believe that every great journey begins with passion and a bold vision. From our
humble beginnings in 1877 in a small shop in Parma, Italy, we've blossomed into a global leader in
the food industry, guided by our commitment to progress and excellence.

Today, Barilla is an international group present in more than 100 countries and we are proud to be

recognized as the world's top food company by reputation. With 20 beloved brands in our portfolio,
we are world leader for pasta, the number one choice for ready-made sauces in Europe, leader for

bakery products in Italy, and for crispbread across Scandinavia with Wasa.

Our success story is written by a passionate team of 9,000 dedicated employees across 30 plants
and offices worldwide, all united by a shared mission to nourish the future with purpose and
passion.

Are you ready to add your unique flavor to our journey?
JOB PURPOSE

Develop together with the Transformation Director new standards of definition, execution and
measurement for key priority transformative projects & processes. The job holder will be
responsible for supporting the Business Integration Office by overseeing the execution and

integration of key transformative initiatives across the entire Organization.

KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES

· Support the Business Integration Office in planning, executing integration initiatives
across various functions in alignment with strategic goals (3YP) and business priorities.
· Contribute to the evolution of the new Barilla way of working towards more flexibility,
agility and responsibility, managing the execution of the Company transformative
projects.

· Coordinate and track the progress of the various key transformative initiatives by
collaborating with different key stakeholders (Initiative leaders, core team members,
ExCo sponsors).

 · Act as a reference point for gathering key requirements and goals from different
stakeholders throughout the process of setting up the Integrated Initiative Plan.
· Prepare and deliver status reports and update on the Integrated Initiative Plan
highlighting risks and opportunities.
· Monitor key performance indicators to assess the effectiveness of the Integrated

Initiative Plan and suggest process improvements (ie. in tracking, way of working, etc.).

· Contribute actively to reinforce the Integrated Initiative Plan in having a solid and
coherent Communication and Change Management Plan.

· Support the Transformation team in directly managing specific Transformative
Initiatives under the Transformation team scope.

REQUIREMENTS

· At least 5/6 years of experience are mandatory

· Track record in Mergers & Acquisitions (M&A) and/ or Post-Merger Integration (PMI)
is mandatory.

· Strong background on project management

· In relevant projects (ie: Tier1/ Company Portfolio Projets)
· Stakeholder management at different levels (ie: senior mgmt, technical ... )
· Project management certification highly preferred (ie: PMP)
· International background / experience in international projects.
· Consultancy background

· Previous experiences in process optimization and systems integration are highly
preferred

· Strong problem solving and analytical skills
· Fluency in English is mandatory

At Barilla, we are committed to creating an inclusive and equitable workplace where diversity in all
its forms is valued and embraced. Our employment policies and practices are designed to ensure
equal employment opportunities for all, regardless of age, race, color, citizenship, faith, religion,
creed, gender, sex, pregnancy, gender identity or characteristics of expression, sexual orientation,
marital status, genetic information, medical condition, protected veteran status, disability, or any

 other characteristic protected by law. With a super nice, new office building, perfect for public
transport; regular team lunches; Cantine; int'l careers, L&D; smart working option to buy products

Our commitment to equal employment stems from our unwavering belief that it is not only the right
thing to do, but it is also a fundamental driver of innovation and business success.

Join BI Impulse, a transformative Finance Data & Tech program, and be part of a

BI Impulse is a major Finance Data & Tech transformation program aimed at delivering
to all Company Business Units a shared Performance Management model and
technology stack (Tagetik EPM & PowerBI) creating the conditions for the controlling
teams to increase efficiency, agility, accuracy and data exploration / analysis

dynamic brands. And the best part? You’ll be supported to grow an impactful career

Company Description
Work smart, have fun and make an impact!
Our purpose is to guide all companies toward a sustainable world. EcoVadis is the leading provider of business sustainability ratings. Our solutions are backed by an international team of experts and powerful
technology. We analyze data and build sustainability scorecards that give companies actionable insights into their environmental, social and ethical risks.
Why apply to EcoVadis? Be a part of the global sustainability change in business. Grow your career. Work with extraordinary people. Feel valued for your contribution.
Learn more about our team and culture on EcoVadis careers page.

Job Description
The Transformation Office operates within the Corporate Development Department, which is tasked with fueling the company's growth through strategic insights, actionable frameworks, and robust operational support.
The department focuses on three main areas:
- Company Strategy, External Growth & Advocacy
- Business Transformation & Change Management
- Corporate Governance, Quality & Data Protection.
The Transformation Office (TO) leads important transversal projects that help our organization grow and work more effectively. These projects include:
- Departmental reorganization: Adjusting team structures to streamline operational workflows
- Tool Implementation or expansion: Introducing new tools or improving existing ones to meet compliance standards and enhance productivity
- Efficiency enhancements: Leveraging internal analytics and advanced process mining to uncover and leverage efficiency opportunities.
- Change Management: Crafting and applying strategies to accelerate change adoption and improve satisfaction among stakeholders.
The objective of this role will be to:
Effectively lead transformational projects and programs.
Develop internal project management capacity by mentoring and supporting project managers.
Improve the quality of program and project preparation, execution and documentation, increasing our project knowledge base, and aggregating project information.
Responsibilities:
Lead program/project, guiding multi-disciplinary team members and engaging with stakeholders to facilitate their advice/decision-making.
Contribute to and lead key TO tasks supporting project mangers, including training sessions, lessons learned discussions, facilitating team meetings, and organizing and updating portfolio information.
Conduct project reviews and post-project assessments, evaluating guidelines, best practices, and template adherence.
Identify areas for improvement and update project materials, templates, and guidelines.
Conduct research, gather data, and prepare reports or presentations on project-related topics, such as planning and progress, risks, budget, resource allocation, communication, and stakeholders.
Own our project management tool (Wrike)

Qualifications
At least 7+ years of practical experience managing projects, preferably in large, complex and multicultural environments
Experience managing programs and reporting progress to various stakeholders
Developing or participating in the definition of project management frameworks and standards within an organization.
Knowledge of project management methodologies/frameworks (Waterfall, Agile, Hybrid, Kanban), change management, and best practices.
Excellent communication skills in English (both written and oral) are a must for collaborating effectively with managers and stakeholders.

 Ability to work autonomously and foster collaboration in a remote and international context.

makes you unique. In your application, we encourage you to remove personal information such as: photographs, marital status, number of children, religion, gender, residential postal code, university graduation date, past
medical or parental leave(s) taken, nationality (instead, please state if you are legally eligible to work in the job region/country), university name (instead, please state any degrees obtained and the study major).

With its "Growing the Difference" strategy, ING addresses significant changes impacting the banking industry;
from changing customer expectations to FinTechs, regulatory requirements, and digitalization.

To enable the execution of our strategy, ING has established the Digital and Scalable Operations. This team aims
to further accelerate the bank's digitalization and scalability efforts, with a strong emphasis on Al. The team
works on the bank's highest priority assignments and can operate in any area of the bank across the board.
If you want to work at the cutting edge of what's possible, surrounded by progressive, inspiring, and supportive
colleagues, there is no better place to invest your talents than with us. Join us and apply today!
What Digital and Scalable Operations does
We leverage process knowledge, data-driven insights and new technologies to drive high-impact transformation
within the bank. We collaborate across functions to solve complex problems and shape the bank's future.
Examples of our work include:

· Shaping and delivering ING's digital strategy by translating vision into actionable outcomes, such as
Al scalable solutions or Straight-Through Processing (STP) processes. With a strong focus on
implementation and tangible impact.
· Translating ING's strategy into Target Operating Models or Service Designs for different business
lines.

· Driving process (re)design journeys of customer-facing processes with a focus on operational
efficiency, client experience, revenue growth, or risk reduction.
· Roll out process leadership and E2E process management in a specific domain
· Providing strategic insights to senior management through developing and measuring digitalization
or efficiency metrics.

· Build and strengthen our own DSO value propositions to continue providing world-class services.

 Senior Process Expert - Digital and Scalable Operations
You applied for this job on October 27, 2025.

. You will manage complex, high quantity, and sometimes contradictory information to effectively
solve problems.

. You will lead the development, maintenance, and enforcement of consistent and comprehensive
performance & KPI management programs to measure, benchmark, and analyse process
performance.

. You will coordinate and monitor the execution of digitalization and scalability initiatives to ensure
delivery with the expected impact, with the right quality and on time.
. You will proactively anticipate dependencies and collaboration across the entire organization with the
parties that need to contribute to delivery on commitments.
. You will support the development of colleagues by providing feedback and coaching on-the-job.
How to succeed

We hire smart people like you for your potential. Our biggest expectation is that you'll stay curious. Keep

learning. Take on responsibility. In return, we'll back you to develop into an even more awesome version of
yourself.

Furthermore, you have:
· An excellent academic background.
. 8+ years of relevant experience in managing and executing complex process improvement and
change programs.
. Experience in working in a global organization and projects with different cultures and maturity
levels.

. Experience in developing/working with process frameworks and standards.
· Experience with process/digitalization technology, like Artificial Intelligence, workflows and reporting.
· Excellent level of English.
· Knowledge regarding (Wholesale) Banking is being considered an advantage
You also bring:

. Hands-on change professional with a strong 'can do' mentality, highly resilient, and able to navigate
through ambiguity.
· High level of pro-activeness and ability to operate independently.
. Strong delivery capability, with a proven track record and credibility in achieving results in strategic
transformation programs, with focus on implementation and impact.
· Able to identify, apply, develop and communicate (reusable) methodologies and frameworks for the
challenge at hand.
· Coordination and project management skills for running multiple concurrent initiatives.
· Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, numerical insight, ability to think of new solutions
("outside of the box").
· Strong willingness and ambition to drive process and cultural change; ability to challenge authority
and speak up.

· Strong interpersonal, communication and stakeholder management skills for interactions with
management and operational staff.
· Organizational sensitivity; deep understanding of the underlying issues, opportunities, and dynamics
of the organization; strong focus on collaboration.

 Senior Process Expert - Digital and Scalable Operations
You applied for this job on October 27, 2025.

· Individual leave: 24+2 individual holiday days based on 36 hr workweek
· Diversity leave: 3 days per year (1,5 paid, 1,5 unpaid)
· CSR days: up to 2 days per year to actively engage in society by volunteering

· 13th month salary
. 8% Holiday payment

· Individual Savings Contribution (BIS), 3.5% of your gross annual salary
· Mobility card
· Attractive pension scheme

. Hybrid working to blend home working for focus and office working for collaboration and co-creation

- CV of max 2 pages and motivation letter of max 1 page. On your motivation letter, detail your reasons why you
want to work in ING, within DSO and with process improvement projects. We only accept applications with a CV
and motivation letter.

Global Senior Manager Group Organization
About Barilla
At Barilla, we believe that every great journey begins with passion and a bold vision. From
our humble beginnings in 1877 in a small shop in Parma, Italy, we've blossomed into a
global leader in the food industry, guided by our commitment to progress and excellence.
Today, Barilla is an international group present in more than 100 countries and we are proud

to be recognized as the world's top food company by reputation. With 22 beloved brands in
our portfolio, we are world leader for pasta, the number one choice for ready-made sauces
in Europe, leader for bakery products in Italy, and for crispbread across Scandinavia with
Wasa.

Our success story is written by a passionate team of almost 9,000 dedicated employees

across 30 plants and offices worldwide, all united by a shared mission to nourish the future
with purpose and passion.

Are you ready to add your unique flavor to our journey?
Job role

We are looking for our next Global Senior Manager Group Organization, based in our Headquarters in
Amsterdam. The role will report to the Group Organization Director.

Job description
As a member of the Global Group Organization Team, this position serves as a strategic advisor to the
Senior HR Leadership Teams, supporting a multi-brand company with more than 20 brands across 26
countries worldwide.

. The role collaborates closely with global, regional, and functional HR leaders to identify and drive strategic,
transformative organizational and people initiatives for Barilla globally. It ensures the integration of effective
organizational and transformation strategies that address regional and business-specific needs while
promoting efficiency and consistency across the company.
· Provides expert support to the business by advising on and implementing organizational design solutions,
optimizing the global operating model, and shaping processes that improve overall organizational
effectiveness. Leads and manages critical change initiatives to support the successful execution of Barilla's
current and future strategic goals.

· Serves as a global expert in job grading and organizational design, ensuring alignment, consistency, and
impact across all aspects of Barilla's people and organizational strategy.

 Responsibilities
· Organizational Strategy and Effectiveness: Drive a consistent and integrated approach to organizational
effectiveness by developing and implementing strategic pillars that include organizational capability strategy,
target operating models, service interaction frameworks, workforce location strategy, strategic workforce
planning, and robust governance and decision-making structures-aligned with the ongoing evolution of the
Global Business Operating Model. Collaborate closely with business leaders to support and shape the
continuous development of the Global Operating Model. Evaluate its effectiveness and alignment with
broader organizational goals and propose alternative solutions where appropriate. Partner with People
Strategy teams to translate HR strategic priorities into organizational evolution and transformational initiatives
that reflect the company's evolving value proposition, talent strategy, and employee experience goals. These
efforts should be supported by OKR frameworks and integrated into the broader HR planning cycle. Support
the development of a transformation-ready workforce by designing and executing upskilling initiatives,
ensuring the organization possesses the capabilities and resilience needed to drive and sustain long-term
transformation. Focus on cultivating next-generation leaders who are adaptable, innovative, and prepared to
lead within a dynamic and transformed organizational landscape.

· Organization Analysis and Design: Serve as a trusted advisor and subject matter expert (SME) to

business and HR leaders, guiding the identification and implementation of organization analysis and design
solutions and advising on organizational development opportunities to optimize structure, performance, and
strategic alignment. Collaborate with global and regional People Analytics teams to establish frameworks that
measure the success and impact of transformation and organizational evolution. Identify key financial,
operational, and employee experience-based metrics to evaluate both efficacy and ROI. Facilitate datadriven discussions within leadership teams (HRL, ExCo, and GLT) to assess short- and long-term impacts of
transformative initiatives. Help allocate global, regional, and local resources and investments based on
strategic priorities, ensuring consistent and equitable outcomes across business units and regions.

. Job Grading and Critical Position Mapping: Act as the global Subject Matter Expert (SME) on job grading

and the Barilla Job Framework. Conduct job evaluations and manage relationships with external providers
(where applicable), ensuring alignment, internal consistency, and equity across the organization. Lead the
critical position mapping process in collaboration with HR and business leaders, identifying roles that are
essential to the organization's strategic objectives, operational continuity, and long-term success. Ensure
these roles are appropriately graded and positioned within the organizational structure to support succession
planning, talent development, and workforce planning efforts. Contribute to the continuous improvement of
job grading and organization design methodologies, processes, and tools by incorporating best practices and
market research. Support talent initiatives connected to the evolution of the career framework by delivering
expert input through benchmarking, training sessions, and workshops.

. HR Transformation and Operating Model Evolution: Support the design and enablement of HR

transformation and the broader organizational strategy by shaping the vision for change in line with Barilla's
long-term goals. Guide the evolution of the HR Operating Model to effectively support a dynamic, global, and
matrixed business environment. Develop a unified and consistent approach for all HR-led organizational
transformation efforts, ensuring strategic alignment across functions, markets, and regions. Help embed
organizational design principles into the transformation process, promoting coherence and strategic clarity.

· Project and Change Management: Lead the planning, execution, and delivery of projects from initiation to

completion by setting clear objectives, developing project plans, coordinating resources, managing risks, and
maintaining effective stakeholder communication. Ensure projects are completed on time, within scope and
budget, and are aligned with Barilla's strategic objectives. Champion selected transformational initiatives,
applying agile methodologies and cross-functional collaboration to accelerate progress. Form and lead task
forces comprised of key experts and stakeholders aligned to priority business areas and the Integrated
Planning process. Supervise cross-functional and regional teams to monitor progress, remove obstacles, and
ensure successful delivery. Promote seamless collaboration across departments (HR, Growth &
Transformation, Finance, IT, etc.) and within HR functions (Business Partners, Communities of Expertise,

People Operations & Services).

. External Trends: Stay abreast of emerging trends in job grading, organizational design, and broader HR
transformation practices through ongoing research and industry benchmarking. Actively participate in
professional communities of practice and external forums to share insights and bring fresh, external

perspectives into Barilla's organizational strategy.

Requirements
A minimum of 8-10 years of progressive experience in HR roles and strategic consulting roles partnering,
with a strong track record in leading workforce planning, and organizational effectiveness, design and

 development within global, matrixed organizations.
· Proven success in leading strategic and transformational HR initiatives at both global and regional levels.
. Demonstrated ability to deliver impactful results in both top-tier consulting firms and complex corporate
environments.

· Extensive experience advising executive leadership teams on people strategy and HR transformation, with a
focus on aligning HR initiatives with overarching business objectives.

Are you ready to drive financial and operational excellence while influencing business

Your new role

As the Finance & Operations (F&O) Director, you will be the strategic finance partner to the
Austrian leadership team, steering and executing the strategic direction for Novo Nordisk

Austria. In collaboration with your team, you will lead pivotal change projects within the
organization, taking charge of Business Finance, Supply Chain Management, Procurement,
Business Insights, and Business Operations as a key business partner.

In this role, you will report directly to the General Manager and be a member of the Novo

Nordisk Austria Leadership Team. This position is office-based and located in Vienna,
Austria, requiring presence at the office five days a week.
Your responsibilities will include to:

· Be a trusted business partner and advisor to the General Manager and the Austrian
Leadership Team, ensuring proactive monitoring of financial performance through
data-driven analysis and insights.

· Oversee the achievement of financial targets by streamlining internal financial
processes through digital innovation, shared services, and outsourcing, while
ensuring strict compliance with local regulations.

. Lead the Business Finance and Operations teams, including the Procurement
department (covering Meetings & Events and Contract Management), and support
Supply Chain Management and Warehousing to ensure timely delivery of products to
customers, securing continuous patient supply.

· Collaborate closely with the Supply Chain responsible for Austria to optimize
operational efficiency and service quality.
· Take ownership of facility and fleet management to ensure optimal functionality and
effective service delivery, supporting overall business objectives.
· Translate strategic objectives into actionable initiatives that empower teams to

achieve positive financial, environmental, and social impacts, enhancing overall
business performance.

 Novo Nordisk is currently in the process of adjusting job titles globally. Please note that the
job title listed in this advertisement may be subject to change. More detailed information
will be provided during the recruitment process.
Your skills & qualifications
As an F&O leader, you are adept at manoeuvring through complex matrix environments,

excelling in cross-functional teams and driving impactful outcomes. With a strong
enterprise business mindset and a proactive can-do attitude, you effectively translate

strategic initiatives into actionable steps that yield positive results. You are a true team
player who values collaboration and actively fosters a positive atmosphere within your
team, contributing to a culture of engagement and success.

· A Master's degree or equivalent in Business or Finance, complemented by a strong
financial background and expertise, as well as a strong analytical mindset.
· 5+ years of relevant finance experience, demonstrating a proven finance partnering
mindset, ideally within an affiliate environment.

· Extensive expertise in financial management, including budget oversight, a deep
understanding of P&L, and the ability to develop and analyse comprehensive business
cases.

· A thorough understanding of the Austrian pharmaceutical market is a significant
advantage.

. Solid verbal and written communication skills, enabling you to engage and influence
stakeholders at all levels of the organization; fluency in German is a distinct
advantage.
About the department
Novo Nordisk Austrian affiliate belongs to Business Area South & West, which is part of the
broader Region Europe and Canada (EUCAN). It is a rapidly expanding and dynamic
organization of 60 employees dedicated to solidifying Novo Nordisk's market presence

through the launch of innovative products and enhancing patient access. Looking ahead, we
have outlined ambitious plans for sustainable growth that leverages our successes while
prioritizing key elements of performance and leadership in the fields of obesity and
diabetes.

Working at Novo Nordisk
We are a proud life-science company, and life is our reason to exist. We're inspired by life in
all its forms and shapes-its ups and downs, opportunities, and challenges. For employees
at Novo Nordisk, life means many things-from the building blocks of life that form the
basis of groundbreaking scientific research, to our rich personal lives that motivate and
energize us to perform at our best. Ultimately, life is why we're all here: to ensure that
people can lead lives independent of chronic disease.

More information
We are an equal opportunities employer, and we commit to an inclusive recruitment process
and equality of opportunity for all our job applicants.
Novo Nordisk is currently in the process of adjusting job titles globally. Please note that the
job title listed in this advertisement may be subject to change. More detailed information
will be provided during the recruitment process.

To submit your application, please upload your CV and motivational letter online (click on
Apply and follow the instructions). Internal candidates are kindly requested to inform their
line Manager before applying.
Deadline

 Apply before October 21st, 2025.
Novo Nordisk is not your typical healthcare company. In a modern world of quick fixes, we
focus on solutions to defeat serious chronic diseases and promote long-term health. Our
unordinary mindset is at the heart of everything we do. We seek out new ideas and put

people first as we push the boundaries of science, make healthcare more accessible, and
treat, prevent, and even cure diseases that affect millions of lives. Because it takes an
unordinary approach to drive real, lasting change in health.

Corporate Strategy Senior Manager
Barilla International B.V. wants to recruit the next Corporate Strategy Senior Manager,
within the Corporate Strategy & Corporate Venturing unit, based in Amsterdam. The
individual will report to the Corporate Strategy Director.
Job Purpose
Within the Corporate Strategy & Corporate Venturing Unit, under the supervision of the
Corporate Strategy Director, the person will contribute driving the company's medium and
long-term vision, Strategic direction, organic and inorganic growth.
Key Accountabilities
. Contribute to shape and guide the Company's medium and long-term vision and strategic
direction, while enhancing its market position through strategic initiatives and identifying
organic and inorganic growth opportunities.
· Strategy Definition: Actively contribute to the elaboration and updating of the Company's
overall strategy, including setting of long-term goals and identification of key areas for
growth and development.
· Strategy Planning: Manage the Company's strategic planning process, ensuring all units
are aligned with the Company's vision and objectives. Guide planning activities performed
by the businesses. Establish and review key strategic priorities and translate them into
actionable and comprehensive plans.
· Strategy Implementation: Advise the Corporate Strategy Director in:
· Strategic Alignment: ensuring all projects and initiatives are in line with the Company's
strategy.
. Performance Management: monitoring progresses and evaluating outcomes to ensure
organizational goals are met. It includes regular reviews and adjustments to strategies
and processes to improve efficiency and effectiveness.
· Business Portfolio Optimization: ensuring alignment against strategic objectives and their
adoption by the businesses; monitoring strategic initiatives against principles of strategic
fit, balance, maximization, and feasibility.
· Strategic Decisions: Scope, manage, and deliver specific strategic projects and
Competitive intelligence, to enable strategic decisions for the CEO, Board, Exco that will
keep the company ahead of industry changes
· Strategic initiatives and long-term growth opportunities (inorganic growth): Assist the
Corporate Strategy Director in identifying and assessing M&A opportunities, Geographic
expansions possibilities and potential assets disposals.
· Contribute to drafting of M&A strategies and scoping of alternative deal structures
. Support end-to-end the M&A Process/deal execution (target identification, valuation, due
diligence, negotiation, integration).
Requirements
· 7 to 10 years working experience, preferably in Consulting, Investment Banking/Private
Equity or Consumer Packaged Goods companies; Experience in the US Market will be
considered a plus.
· Relevant M&A experience, with exposure to international transactions and involvement
in post-merger integration
· Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with ability to distill complex data and analysis
into clear actionable insights.
· Strong team player, with very good relational skills and emotional intelligence.
· Strong oral and written communication skills.
· Autonomy and comfort with new, blank-piece-of-paper assignment.
· Intellectual curiosity, "can do" attitude and results orientation.
· International mindset, ability to work in a global environment and with virtual teams.
· Ability to handle simultaneous projects under deadline pressure.
· Problem-Solving with ability to think critically and find effective solutions to challenges.
· Details-oriented, meticulous, and thorough in analysis and execution.
Additional Information
· Expected starting date: June 2025
· Local permanent contract

Global Strategy Director
What We Need

Corpay is currently looking to hire a Global Strategy Director within our IVP Commercial team. This position falls
under our International Vehicle Payments (IVP) line of business and is located in London, Victoria.
In this pivotal role, you will be driving organic & inorganic growth and will be a catalyst in shaping the company's
future success. Within the context of our overall vision, and by advocating the big picture with drive and passion,
you will work both strategically and tactically to assess market opportunities, to conceptualize new ideas,
present options and pitch to senior leaders. All this supported by compelling strategic rationale and quantitative
business case analysis.

In order to thrive, you will possess a blend of business, strategic and new market development capabilities,
technical awareness, along with excellent problem solving capability. In addition, you are highly motivated, a selfstarter, capable of working both independently and in teams, across multiple projects, with ambitious drive and
spirit. You will also possess a strong work ethic, intellectual curiosity, and be numerate and analytical, with the
appetite and willingness to take ownership of projects and follow-through from initiation through completion.
You will report directly to our Chief Commercial Officer, IVP and regularly collaborate with the wider Strategy
team, IVP business leaders and supporting teams across Europe and the UK.
How We Work

 As a Global Strategy Director, you will be expected to work in a hybrid office environment. Corpay will set you up
for success by providing:
· Assigned workspace in Vincent Square, London (Victoria)
· Company-issued equipment
· Formal, hands-on training. Support for you to complete professional certifications.
Role Responsibilities

The responsibilities of the role will include performing and/or managing the following:
Strategic Planning and Development:
. Lead the formulation, development, and execution of corporate strategic plans including annual
budgeting & target setting.
· Conduct thorough market research and analysis to identify trends, opportunities, and threats.
· Collaborate with senior leadership to set strategic priorities and goals.
· Develop business models and scenarios to support strategic decision-making.
Lead Execution and Performance Monitoring:

· Lead the implementation of strategic initiatives and projects.
· Establish performance metrics and monitoring systems to track progress against strategic goals.
· Provide regular updates to the executive team on the status of strategic initiatives.

Market, Partnerships and M&A:
· Monitor industry trends, market conditions, and competitor activities.
. Identify emerging market opportunities including potential M&A and partnerships.
· Develop competitive intelligence strategies to inform business decisions.
Cross-functional Collaboration:

. Work closely with department heads to ensure alignment of strategic initiatives across the
organization.

. Facilitate cross-functional team meetings to drive collaboration and innovation.
· Support teams in translating strategic goals into operational plans.
Stakeholder Engagement:

· Engage with key stakeholders, including investors, partners, and customers, to communicate the
company's strategic direction.

· Build and maintain relationships with external partners to support strategic initiatives.
Qualifications & Skills
· Bachelor's (required) or Master's (preferably MBA) Degree in Business, Finance, Economics,
Management or related field

. Prior experience working in strategy in a corporate environment or consulting firms.
· Strategic thinker with the ability to see the big picture and attention to detail.
. Strong organization management and time management skills; ability to multitask and work well with
urgency, while maintaining a strong attention to detail, and prioritising work within tight deadlines
· Effective written & oral communication skills, interpersonal skills, and the ability to connect with
employees at all levels of the organization

 Benefits & Perks

· Competitive salary (depending on experience) + bonus
. 25 days annual leave plus public holidays. Plus a holiday buy back scheme
· Pension scheme

. Health and wellness programs
· Significant career progression opportunities, with potential to take on a wider role in the future
· Opportunity to join a leading brand in a high growth global business
· Fun culture with company-wide contests and prizes
Our Company & Purpose

Corpay is a global leader in business payments, laser focused on developing smarter ways for businesses to pay
their expenses. Since 2000, Corpay has developed innovative digital solutions that help businesses better track,
manage, and pay their expenses. Today, Corpay is an S&P 500 company with hundreds of thousands of
customers using our products in over 100 countries. Companies of all sizes, industries and geographies rely on
our product portfolio to manage spending more quickly, efficiently and securely than ever before.
We embrace a culture grounded in five key values: integrity, collaboration, innovation, execution and people.
These values offer you the opportunity to 'thrive & grow' through career development, volunteer, community, and

· Valuing each person's unique perspectives and individual contributions.
Embracing diversity enables our people to "make the difference" as CORPAY and its more than 8,000 employees

Head of Corporate Strategy
Imagine a future where you play a pivotal role in shaping our company’s journey to
realise its full potential as a global leader in renewable energy

We’re looking for our next Head of Corporate Strategy. In this role, you’ll work closely
with our CEO and top management team in driving the corporate strategic agenda and
‘connecting the dots’ by formulating and supporting the execution of our corporate
strategy. You’ll take a ‘hands-on’ approach, supported by a team of highly skilled
individuals. The role requires you to actively engage with multiple stakeholders across
the company and continuously seek and develop new insights from internal and external
sources to support strategic decision-making.

Welcome to Corporate Strategy
You’ll be part of a dynamic team where you, together with your colleagues, will drive
and support the formulation and execution of our company’s corporate strategy.
As a team, we collaborate closely, embrace learning, challenge each other
constructively, and support growth through shared insights and hands-on development.

You’ll play an important role in:
● driving our corporate strategic agenda and leading high-impact projects across the

group
● leading the strategy process, a key part of our annual performance management
● conducting industry, peer, and other market analyses that provide insight into our
journey
● liaising with our teams in corporate finance and capital allocation, M&A,
commercial, and digital strategy
● acting as a strategic advisor and challenger to senior leadership, including the CEO
and board
● managing a team of strategists and ensuring high-quality deliverables for executive
management and board meetings

 ● preparing presentations and material for executive management meetings and

representing us at key internal and external events.

To succeed in the role, you:
● hold a master’s degree in business, economics, finance, or a similar field, combined

with top-tier management consulting experience or similar experience from
comparable industry
● demonstrate excellent stakeholder management and political acumen, with the
ability to influence and challenge senior executives
● have a strong analytical approach and structured problem-solving skills, with the
ability to simplify analysis into clear insight and communication
● are able to think outside the box and provide independent and original thinking
● have a strong leadership track record from managing high-performing teams in toptier advisory firms and/or in a large corporation
● set high standards for the quality of your work and excel in both oral and written
communication.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even
though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the
team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us
Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a
continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the
right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position
accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit

Manager Data Driven Banking
(m/w/d)

Apply

Berlin, Frankfurt, Hamburg, Köln, München, Stuttgart

Wir bei Capgemini Invent glauben, dass unterschiedliche Perspektiven den Wandel
vorantreiben. Als innovative Transformationsberater vereinen wir unsere strategischen,

kreativen und wissenschaftlichen Fähigkeiten und arbeiten eng mit unseren Kunden
zusammen, um zukunftsweisende Lösungen zu entwickeln. Hilf uns dabei, den Wandel
voranzutreiben, der auf die Herausforderungen unserer Kunden von heute und morgen
zugeschnitten ist. Informiert und validiert durch Wissenschaft und Daten. Verstärkt durch

Kreativität und Design. Und das alles auf der Grundlage von Technologien.

Deine Rolle

Als Manager im Bereich Data Driven Banking leistet du erste spannende (Teil-) Projekte
bei Banken und Finanzdienstleistern. Du hilfst ihnen dabei, das volle Potenzial von Daten
und Künstlicher Intelligenz (Al) zu nutzen:
· Du unterstützt die Transformation von Geschäftsmodellen und Prozessen - von der

End-to-End Prozessdigitalisierung bis zu Al-basierten Innovationen im Finanzsektor
· Du berätst das Management führender Banken und Finanzinstitute bei der
Entwicklung und Umsetzung von Strategien, insbesondere im Corporate- und
Retail-Banking
. Gemeinsam mit unserem Team entwickelst und implementierst du Al-Strategien,
datenbasierte Produkte und Technologiestrategien in den Bereichen Analytics und
Data Management, um Effizienz zu steigern, neue Kundenerlebnisse zu schaffen und
unsere Marktposition zu stärken

· Du übernimmst Verantwortung für Teams und Projekte

· Du begeisterst dich für Banking, Daten und Generative Al sowie für die Entwicklung
innovativer Strategien, die datengetriebene Organisationen und Geschäftsmodelle
ermöglichen

· Du bist kommunikationsstark und überzeugst durch deinen Teamgeist sowie ein
hohes Engagement und selbstbewusstes Auftreten

· Du hast bereits Teams geführt oder Projekte geleitet
· Du besitzt sehr gute Deutsch- und Englischkenntnisse und zeigst Flexibilität und
Reisebereitschaft

Was du bei uns schätzen wirst

· Werde Teil einer international führenden Unternehmensberatung, die durch
innovative und wegweisende Projekte, globale Teams und digitales Know-How die
Zukunft gestaltet
· Bekomme klare Perspektiven für deine Karriere und Freiraum für Eigeninitiative
· Erhalte individuelle Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten

· Erlebe unser kontinuierliches Engagement für Chancengleichheit, Vielfalt und
Inklusion

· Profitiere von unseren Benefits zur optimalen Work-Life-Balance mit attraktiven
Angeboten rund um Gesundheit & Wellbeing, Zusatzpaketen rund um Mobilität
sowie modernen Offices

Über Capgemini
Capgemini ist ein globaler Partner für die KI-gestützte Geschäfts- sowie

Technologietransformation. Das Unternehmen schafft messbaren Mehrwert für seine
Kunden, indem es die Zukunft von Organisationen gestaltet und im Zusammenspiel von
KI, Technologie sowie dem Mensch Realität werden lässt. Seit fast 60 Jahren steht
Capgemini für Verantwortung wie auch Vielfalt und beschäftigt über 420.000
Mitarbeitende in mehr als 50 Ländern. Das End-to-End-Leistungsspektrum gründet auf
einer umfangreichen Branchenexpertise, einem starken Partner-Ökosystem sowie

Kompetenzen in den Bereichen Strategie, Technologie, Design, Engineering und

Operations. Die Gruppe erzielte 2025 einen weltweiten Umsatz von 22,5 Milliarden Euro.

 Wir freuen uns über deine vollständige Bewerbung ausschließlich über unser

Bewerbungsportal und unter Angabe deiner Gehaltsvorstellung, des frühestmöglichen

Eintrittszeitpunkts sowie deiner Standortpräferenz.

(Senior) Manager Business Strategy & Transformation
(f/m/d)
Hybrid · Banking · Full time
Munich, Bavaria, Germany
Berlin, Berlin, Germany
Vienna, Vienna, Austria
Walldorf, Baden-Württemberg, Germany

OVERVIEW

Description

APPLICATION

Share this job

Innovation is and will always be the core to SAP Fioneer, and it is the promise of why we
were spun out of SAP: agility, innovation, and delivery.
SAP Fioneer builds on a heritage of outstanding technology and a deep understanding of
corporate and consumer demands. At the heart of it all it is simple: We bring financial
services to the next level with innovative software solutions and platforms.
We are helping companies in the financial services industry to achieve speed, scalability,
and cost-efficiency through digital business innovation, cloud technology, and solutions
that cover banking and insurance processes end-to-end.
A global company, with rapid growth, innovative people, and a lean organization makes
SAP Fioneer a place where you accelerate your future!
The Role
We are seeking an exceptional (Senior) Manager to join our dynamic strategy and
transformation practice. This individual will play a pivotal role in shaping and executing
high-impact strategies for leading financial institutions, guiding them through complex
challenges and identifying growth opportunities. You will work closely with senior
leadership and cross-functional teams to drive transformation, innovation, and sustainable
competitive advantage for our clients.
Key Responsibilities
Shape SAP Fioneer's future strategy for the Financial Service world in co-innovation
projects together with our clients:
Defining our Business Value Proposition for leading banks and insurances
Bringing expert level credibility to our cases and business development opportunities
Analyzing and discussing business needs with the C-Level of our key clients and
helping them to actively shape their transformation journey, collaboratively create new
solutions and extend the SAP Fioneer product footprint and services at these clients
Taking full ownership of managing complex transformation projects including relevant
co-innovation projects with our key clients end-to-end at the intersection of business
and IT – negotiation with and management of joined delivery with partner included
Lead and collaborate with multi-disciplinary teams to address client challenges and
deliver results

Requirements
6+ years of experience in successfully shaping and/or delivering large-scale digital
innovation and transformation projects for banks or insurances in international
strategy (IT) consultancies, financial services or related fields
Experience in managing multiple internal and external stakeholders incl. third parties
and expertise in one of the following fields: core banking and payments, lending, bank

 management incl. risk, or insurance finance
Ability to pro-actively interact and discuss new solutions with a variety of stakeholders
such as C-level management, sales teams, product engineering departments and to
lead and guide a motivated team
Proven contributions to sales of digital transformation projects at large banks/ insurers
and strong network in the Financial Services industry
Strong problem-solving skills and ability to synthesize complex information into
actionable insights.
High degree of intellectual curiosity, with a passion for financial markets and business
strategy.
Strong leadership and mentoring abilities.
Business fluent in English and German
Master in business administration, mathematics, commerce or STEM

Benefits
Be part of a small, high-performance team and create exceptional business cases and
value
Become a leading FSIS innovator with corresponding market reputation
Attractive “Path to Partner” or advance your career to leadership in one of our
divisions
You will have the opportunity to collaborate with some of the brightest minds in the
industry on an incredibly ambitious project to shape the ever-evolving financial sector.
This is an environment where you can have it all - the agility, enthusiasm and dynamism
of a start-up, combined with the established expertise, solid market presence and
extensive customer network of a more established organisation.
At SAP Fioneer, you will benefit from a flexible work environment that encourages
creativity and encourages you to think outside the box, bring new ideas to the table, and
challenge the status quo. You will become part of a diverse and global team that we are
proud of and are constantly growing and reinventing. As an employee, you will have the
chance to chart your own career path and take advantage of competitive compensation
packages and progression opportunities based on merit.
We offer a comprehensive benefits package that includes occupational pension
provisions, support for health and wellbeing, various mobility options like bike leasing and
transportation allowances, as well as additional perks such as celebration rewards, meal
programs, jubilee recognition, and relocation reimbursement.

Apply for this job

SAP Fioneer collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. If
you are a European Job Applicant see the privacy notice for further details. If you are a California Job
Applicant see the privacy notice for further details.
SAP Fioneer does not discriminate on the basis of race, sex, color, religion, age, national origin, marital

VISA
Senior Manager, Strategy & Commercial Operations - Stockholm/Copenhagen
Copenhagen, Denmark
nī Employees work in a hybrid mode
Full-time
Job Family Group: Strategy
Company Description
Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across
more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.
At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale - tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact
lives around the world. Join Visa and do work that matters - to you, to your community, and to the world.
Progress starts with you.
Job Description
What it is all about:
The Senior Manager for the Strategy and Commercial Operations team is responsible for executing parts of the cluster strategy, helping to set cluster level
targets, and driving delivery to ensure the cluster meets or exceeds its financial and scorecard goals. The role reports into the Head of Strategy and
Commercial Operations for the cluster.
What we expect of you, day by day:
· Partner with the team to execute the Visa Europe strategy at the cluster and country level
. Identify and support the development of new Generative Al use cases
- Collaborate with Country Mennene and tenmeto dunlen alene aligned with etentrain annla
· Lead key cluster operational activities, including preparation of executive visit materials
· Provide input on workforce data quality and support internal audit readiness
· Manage risk registers and identify opportunities for process improvement
· Contribute to setting regional business performance targets and strategic investment planning
· Develop governance materials to support performance tracking and decision-making
· Support the management of the overall sales pipeline and foster a performance-driven culture
. Prioritize client feedback and collaborate with the Sales Excellence team
· Contribute to the development of sales training strategies
· Engage directly with clients to support strategic planning and content creation for Client Councils
· Implement cluster governance, including leadership meetings and offsite planning
· Create content for Quarterly and Monthly Business Reviews (QBRs and MBRs)
· Promote governance simplification and improved decision-making processes
· Collaborate with Corporate Strategy teams to build strategic frameworks and thought leadership materials
· Contribute to strategic components of client RFP responses and country-level strategy presentations
· Ensure alignment across MSO, AOP, and QBR processes to drive cohesive execution
This is a hybrid position. Expectation of days in the office will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.
Qualifications
What we're after ...
· Proven experience in a relevant strategic, commercial, or consulting role
. Background in top-tier consultancy or similarly complex environments is a strong advantage
· Demonstrated commercial and financial acumen with the ability to drive business impact
· Experience working in multinational, diverse, and matrixed organizations
· Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities, with a data-driven mindset
· Ability to collaborate effectively with senior stakeholders and cross-functional teams
· Proactive, hands-on approach with a high degree of agility and resourcefulness
· A mindset focused on innovation, continuous improvement, and leading change
Additional Information
Visa is an EEO Employer. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, sexual
orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status. Visa will also consider for employment qualified applicants with criminal histories in a
manner consistent with EEOC guidelines and applicable local law.

ARC'TERYX

Director, Finance - EMEA (m/f/d)
Garching, Munich

Finance - Financial Planning & Analysis / Full-Time / Hybrid

Your Opportunity at ARC'TERYX:
As the Director, Finance - EMEA, you are responsible for the Finance team in support of the
EMEA operations at Arc'teryx. You, along with your team will support the region's growth

plans through ownership of the EMEA Finance reporting and planning cycle, including the
long-range planning process, annual operating plan, forecasting processes and monthly
reporting. In addition to financial planning, you will review monthly performance and work
closely with Group shared services and Brand HQ accounting teams to ensure accuracy and
completeness with our financial close. You will provide senior management with the analysis
to understand business trends, make investment decisions and track and monitor performance
to enable the region to deliver on its goals.

This role is based out of our Garching office, near Munich, Germany or in London, UK. The
position is open to hybrid work (3 days in the office, 2 days at home and 1 day at the
discretion of the manager ). Candidates must be eligible to work in Germany or in the UK.

Meet Your Future Team:

The Finance team at Arc'teryx is responsible for providing leadership with the information
they need to review past performance, understand business trends, and anticipate future

 profitability and financial position. Through review of historic financials, variance analysis and
KPI tracking, finance advises leadership on key investment decisions and drives performance
improvement.

If you were in the Director, Finance - EMEA role now, here are some of the core
activities you would be doing:
· Plan, forecast, report and financially accountable for the EMEA Regional P&L
· Lead and build a high performing Finance team, developing future leaders at Arc'teryx and
recognizing and building your leaders area of expertise

· Preparing and maintaining the long-range 5 year plan for the EMEA region. Connecting the
regional strategy with the key drivers, inputs and investments required to deliver on the
region's' plans

· Driving the annual planning cycle, including setting financial goals, managing calendar and
milestones in accordance with Brand HQ guidelines, roll-up and analytical review of the
region Budget, and finalizing and presenting of plans to senior leadership

· Leading the EMEA FP&A team performing daily/weekly/monthly sales and financial reviews
and leading the assessment of risks and opportunities against our plans
· Evolving the format of business performance discussions, from weekly sales reviews to

monthly and quarterly financial presentations and identify opportunities for
improvement/efficiency
· Plan, forecast and report against our SG&A and expense plans for the region
· Provide decision support and analysis to support our Regional departments and functions
. Work with Group shared services and Brand HQ accounting teams to ensure accuracy and
completeness of monthly and quarterly financial close.
· Assess, build and strengthen EMEA specific accounting and reporting capabilities

· Leading key review discussions with Region leadership team (budget, quarterly forecasting),
delivering quantitative analytic work that unlocks business insights and drives decision
making.

· Presenting and reviewing financial performance with the Brand HQ Finance team

· · Developing the process for key regional investment and capital spending projects . You
critically assess business cases, and conduct post completion reviews of budget vs actual

 spend

· Bringing insights and best practices to drive process improvement and innovative thinking.
· Developing a network with industry leaders across EMEA
· Performing ad-hoc reporting and other duties as assigned

Are you our next Director, Finance - EMEA?
· You have 12+ years of experience as a finance leader ideally with a focus the retail industry
· You have a university degree in Commerce or Business Administration coupled with CPA or

MBA

· You have exceptional analytical and modeling skills and expert knowledge of financial
statements

· You ideally have international business experience, or have experience working in a global,
matrixed organization

· You have demonstrated ability to drive projects across an organization
. You can step in and take charge with minimum instruction
· You can prioritize and manage multiple tasks within tight deadlines
· You have excellent written and verbal communication skills

· You have experience working with BI tools and multi-platform, multi-currency
environments

· Familiar with global ERPs (such as SAP) and financial planning tools (ie: Oracle)
· You are proactive in identifying the root cause of issues and developing solutions
· You inspire breakthrough thinking and continuous improvement
· You seek the best (but sometimes not the easiest) solutions, with an unwavering
commitment
· You have an interest or involvement in activities that we make products for

· Your passion for your work is paralleled by your passion for getting outside and living it

Equal Opportunity

 Arc'teryx is committed to actively creating and fostering a culture of inclusivity where voices
are heard, people are seen, and values are respected. We care about the uniqueness of our
applicants, employees, and guests, and we do so in a safe space fueled by curiosity and
acceptance.

Creating an inclusive workplace is connected to our core value Do Right while also having the
added benefit of helping make our business better. We believe inclusion helps us to create a
healthier, happier workplace, drive creativity and innovation, and reflect the communities
where we operate.

All applicants, employees, and guests can expect equality of opportunity and fair treatment in
alignment with our values.
Leave it Better

We believe that the mountains transform us, that how we adventure matters, and that there's
always a better way.

Join us in creating positive change in ourselves, our communities, and the world.
Live it. Get out there - the mountains make us better
Disruptive evolution. In pursuit of better. Always.

Commit. We set bold objectives and see them through.

Controlling Manager - Vienna

At Western Union, we're more than a trusted name in global payments. We're moving beyond

remittances, beyond cash, and beyond the expectations of our customers.

Our talented teams enable us to transform into a digital-first company, built on the strength of our
retail foundation and powered by next-generation payments. All this with the goal of helping people
prosper.

Our customers inspire us to push boundaries and create services that make life easier and

communities stronger. Wherever you are in the world, we're committed to shaping the next
generation of financial experiences.
Join us as we go beyond and be part of a team that's redefining what's possible.
Are you ready to steer financial performance and provide strategic insights in an international
banking environment? At Western Union International Bank (WUIB), we connect people and
businesses worldwide - securely, quickly, and reliably. With our Beyond strategy, we go beyond
money transfers to develop innovative solutions that make our customers' lives easier and help
them move forward financially. Strong financial oversight and data driven decision-making are
essential to ensuring sustainable growth and long-term success.

In this role, you will shape the strategic direction of the Controlling function and act as a key

business partner to senior leadership across the organisation. You will oversee financial planning,
budgeting, and forecasting processes, and ensure transparent, accurate reporting that enables

effective decision-making. You will strengthen financial governance, drive performance

optimisation, and support the sustainable scaling of new products and markets-contributing

directly to innovation and customer value.

 Role Responsibilities
· Execute operating plans and forecast modelling.

· Develop and refine financial models and analytical frameworks to support a changing
business environment.

· Conduct detailed business analysis and reporting to support business operations and key
initiatives.
· Analyse business risks and opportunities and recommend actionable plans.
· Ensure overall financial steering of the bank.

· Serves as a tactical, day-to-day business partner to business teams.
· Set priorities and deliver comprehensive financial support including profitability
analysis, initiative performance assessment, and cost control.

· Identifies and implements process improvement initiatives within the area of
responsibility.
· Perform supervisory responsibilities inherent to a managerial position.

Role Requirements
· Degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Administration, or a related

discipline.
· 5+ years of finance/controlling function within the financial services or banking sector.

· Proven ability to work cross functionally on business and CFO projects.
· Strong expertise in budgeting, forecasting, multi-year planning, and cost management.
· Advanced Excel skills and strong financial modelling capabilities.
· Experience working with ERP systems.
· Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to collaborate

effectively with diverse stakeholders.
· Highly organised and detail oriented, able to provide clear planning direction and
guidance to business teams.
· Fluent in English; German language skills are a nice-to-have.

We make financial services accessible to humans everywhere. Join us for what's next.
Western Union is well-positioned to become the world's most accessible financial services

company-transforming lives and communities. More than moving money, we design easy to use
products and services across our digital and physical financial ecosystem that help customers move
forward.

Just as we support our global customers in achieving their goals, we empower our employees to
reach theirs. You'll have opportunities to grow your skills, shape your career, and enjoy a highly
competitive compensation package. If you're ready to help drive the future of financial services, it's
time for Western Union. Learn more about our purpose and people at
https://careers.westernunion.com.

Salary
We are legally required to state the minimum salary for this position, which is EUR 70,200 gross
per year. However, our attractive compensation packages are aligned with current market levels and
may therefore significantly exceed this minimum.
Benefits

You will have access to short term incentives, multiple health insurance options, accident and life
insurance, and best in class development platforms, among other benefits.

 (https://careers.westernunion.com/global-benefits/).
Austria-specific benefits include:
· Contributory pension plan

· Luncheon vouchers

· Additional partner discounts

Please note that your recruiter may share more role specific benefits during the interview process or
with an offer of employment.
Western Union values in person collaboration, learning, and ideation whenever possible. We
believe this strengthens our ways of working, supports enterprise objectives, and accelerates
innovation. Face to face connection enables better learning, problem solving, and team cohesion.
This role is categorised as Hybrid, meaning you will divide your time between remote work and our
office. The expectation is a minimum of three days per week on site.
