jdText:
Director, FP&A Group Financial Planning
Are you a strategic, visionary leader with a passion for global finance?
Join us as our next Director, FP&A Group Financial Planning and help shape the financial future
of one of the world's most iconic brands!

The purpose of the Group FP&A function is to take ownership of managing and steering the
financial performance of Pandora Group, and we play a vital role in defining and enforcing the
global performance management framework and policies across Global Finance. This includes
being the driver of planning, budgeting and forecasting, defining KPIs, management reporting,
models used in Pandoras ability to provide the right guidance on expected future performance to the
capital market.

The Group FP&A function houses the analytical skillsets and value-chain insight needed to act as a
finance business partner for both the CEO and CFO, as well as overseeing Group's financial
performance and financial planning.

As Director, FP&A Group Financial Planning, you will work cross-functionally on performance
management direction setting and performance insights, build and communicate financial targets,
oversee the planning process and drive scenario building in close collaboration with key business
and finance stakeholders. The FP&A planning team is a key business partner to the Group CFO and
SVP Corporate Finance, providing financial insights to support guidance and investor
communication.

The role requires a combination of strong business acumen, strategic mindset and value-chain
insight. Experience in commercial finance or financial planning is preferred, along with a deep
understanding of P&L and Balance Sheet. You will take strong ownership in driving Pandora's
planning and forecasting process, ensuring we have accurate, streamlined and agile processes.

This is a high pace role with considerable senior stakeholder visibility. There will be ample

opportunity to develop the role. We are therefore looking for a person who has a strong mindset of
constantly improving and streamlining, both from a process and technology perspective. You will
be a role model for analytical excellence, with a natural ability to connect reporting and analysis to
drive actionable insights. You ask the right questions to understand the links between performance
drivers and financial outcomes, and you thrive on curiosity and clarity.

Further, you will:
· Drive process and execution discipline including global standardization and efficiencies
for Pandora in the digital planning area

 · Develop reporting to Pandora's Executive Leadership Team and Board of Directors on
budget and forecast scenarios
· Build and maintain strong relationships and act as a trusted business partner across
functions

· Lead and energize an analytical team, ensuring strong engagement and direction, while
fostering a culture of curiosity and continuous improvement
· Build solid succession planning and talent pipeline, providing ongoing coaching to
strengthen the team's performance, and supporting the members to achieve their career
development goals

Limited international travelling is to be expected.

Your New Team

Pandora offers an exciting and challenging role in a fast-moving, international environment. You

will be part of a dynamic team, working in close cooperation with a strong organization where
quality and integrity are significant qualities. We are a dynamic organization where we are guided
by four values: We dream, We dare, We care and We deliver on our promises to colleagues,
customers, partners and stakeholders.

You will lead a team of~5 direct reports and be part of the wider Group FP&A team based in

Pandora HQ (Copenhagen). You will report directly to the VP of Group FP&A.

What We Hope To See In Your Profile

At Pandora, we recognize that it takes winning personalities to create winning cultures. We believe
it is of essence that you bring a combination of strong business acumen, interpersonal and
influencing skills, as well as a solid understanding of classic FP&A combined with a strong digital
reporting experience.

In addition, we hope to see:
· Experience from similar Director role(s) and responsibility in a global organization
· Experience leading and developing a high performing team
· Strong stakeholder management and business partnering skills, with a natural ability to
make things happen through others
· Proven ability to connect reporting and analysis

· A collaborative mindset and strong curiosity to understand the business deeply
· Experience from retail, fashion or FMCG industry

· Fluent in English - verbally and written
Did we get your attention?

 If you see yourself in the position and would like to become a part of Pandora's future, please do
not hesitate to apply. We look forward to hearing from you!
We process applications on a continuous basis, which is why we encourage you to send your
application as soon as possible. You can also read more about Pandora on our corporate site
www.pandoragroup.com.
Icing on the cake

You will be working out of our beautiful Head Office in Copenhagen V, established in 2016 and
designed to unite and inspire our teams. Besides our beautiful interior design we are also proud of
our LEED Gold Certification for Energy and Environmental Design. This means that we use as few
natural resources as possible and that we use them with respect. The result is a professional and
dynamic space that is unique, comfortable and inspirational - and delivers a true Pandora
experience to anyone who works here or comes to visit.
About Pandora

Pandora is the world's largest jewellery brand, specialising in the design, crafting and marketing of
accessible luxury jewellery made from high-quality materials. Each piece is created to inspire selfexpression, allowing people to share their stories and passions through meaningful jewellery.
Pandora jewellery is sold in more than 100 countries through 6,800 points of sale, including more
than 2,700 concept stores.

Headquartered in Copenhagen, Denmark, Pandora employs 37,000 people worldwide and crafts its
jewellery using only recycled silver and gold. Pandora is committed to leadership in sustainability
and has set out to halve greenhouse gas emissions across its value chain by 2030. Pandora is listed

on the Nasdaq Copenhagen stock exchange and generated revenue of DKK 31.7 billion (EUR 4.2
billion) in 2024.

At Pandora, we believe that creating an inclusive and diverse workplace and reflecting societal
diversity in our customer engagement is essential to delivering on our company purpose: to give a
voice to people's loves. We dedicate ourselves to fostering, cultivating and preserving a culture of

inclusion and diversity where everyone feels respected and valued.

Job Description
People First - At Takeda we are dedicated to improving the health and well-being of all people
and bringing them the hope of a brighter future. It is our passion that transforms every job into
meaningful action. Our people are the heart of Takeda. Are you looking for a patient-focused,
innovation-driven company that will inspire you and empower you to shine?
We are currently seeking for a Head of Finance (all genders) as part of our Country Leadership
Team, to be based in our Austrian local country organization in Vienna.
ROLE OBJECTIVE
Join Takeda Austria as Head of Finance and Supply Chain to drive financial performance, lead
strategic decisions, manage risk and compliance, oversee supply chain excellence, and develop
high-performing teams within Takeda’s PTRB priorities and global standards.
Key objectives of this role include:
The Head of Finance and Supply Chain's main responsibilities include achieving
performance (esp. financial) objectives in line with Takeda's PTRB priorities, guiding
resource allocation effectively, and driving change initiatives to achieve these goals.
Co-pilot within the organization, providing knowledge on relevant financial issues and
ensuring compliance with financial and local requirements.
Member of the Leadership Team (LT), participating in strategic, investment, budgetary,
and planning decisions, leveraging deep understanding of opportunities, risks, and
business drivers.
In collaboration with TBS / corporate functions, analysing all relevant business
transactions, being responsible for the entire BS and P&L of the legal entity.
Lead the Supply Chain team, ensuring continuity of supply/service levels, and
compliance with all company and regulatory requirements.
Ensure a robust system of internal controls and oversee risk management, being
responsible for the results of the external audit.

 Finally, develop and lead the Finance and Supply teams, attracting and retaining talent
and developing capabilities.
YOUR ACCOUNTABILITIES
Financial Performance Management:
Lead the annual budgeting and strategic planning processes (e.g. MRP, MYC, LRF,
other forecasts as necessary), to optimise capital allocation and P&L performance.
Support the functional and divisional heads in the target preparation.
Ensure preparation of all relevant performance reports for LT monthly, including
analysis in comparison with historical and budget objectives
Review Business financial performance, acting as a constructive challenger and partner
internally to maximize business success
Create an environment and culture of continuous improvement in financial systems and
processes to provide the most accurate and efficient financial information to enable the
achievement of business commitments.
Business Partnering / Co-piloting:
Connect the LOC to the wider Takeda organization, helping people to understand the
wider corporate context
Conduct regular reviews with Business to understand what drives the business, act as a
challenger and partner internally to maximize business success
Actively drive performance and resource (re)allocation topics (e.g. Portfolio
Assessment), ask questions and provoke action points to drive the business
Responsible for both Management Accounts and Legal Entity accounts
Support contract negotiations with customers. These are typically large and complex
service contracts with sophisticated payment schemes depending on the operational
model e.g., distribution agreements
Understanding impact of industry trends on business risks and opportunities
Internal Control:
Conduct regular balance sheet review meetings - balance sheet reconciliation /
justifications delivered by region / BU
Key contact/entry point for relations with external auditors and with external
stakeholders (tax audits…) and for internal matters (Transfer pricing, insurance, etc.)
Ensures Finance policies and procedures are in line with local laws and regulations as
well as compliant with Takeda SOP
Monitoring compliance related regulations / industry association positions to proactively
identify emerging regulatory issues, development in industry practices and standards,
and compliance risk trends..
Supply Chain management:
Ensure all supply chain KPIs are met, with consistent product availability across the
portfolio in line with commercial objectives, minimising any shortages and managing
external providers.
Co-ordination with wider Takeda teams:
Establish network to business in the country, providing high quality accounting and tax
support to internal stakeholders (Tax incl. Transfer Pricing, Treasury, Legal, Business
Development, EUCAN Supply Chain etc.).
Member of CSEE Finance Leadership team, contribute actively to broader agenda and
suggest/undertake relevant initiatives as agreed
Alignment with the whole Austrian Finance Team (from the plants)

jdText:
Head/VP of FP&A (all genders)
About Lingoda
Founded 12 years ago, Lingoda addresses a pressing global challenge: meeting the demands
of growing economies and aging populations through the mobility of global talent. Driven by
its mission "to empower global talent with the language, cultural, and technical skills for
integration and success", Lingoda has established itself as a leader in education.
What We Do
Lingoda’s highly effective Small Group Learning Model is delivered via over 800,000 classes a
year, powered by 2,400 qualified teachers and a unique proprietary curriculum. While our
foundation is in language learning, our offering goes much further: we also provide
preparation for professional certification and regulatory exams in the German healthcare
sector, as well as tailored programs designed to support career progression, workforce
integration, and lifelong learning. In doing so, Lingoda enables learners not only to
communicate effectively but also to meet the professional and legal requirements for working
in new countries and industries.
Who We Serve
A rapidly growing and ambitious company, Lingoda operates across B2C, B2B, and B2B2G.
Our B2C business has a global presence, teaching German, English, Spanish, French, and
Italian to students worldwide. On the B2B and B2B2G side, we partner with employers,
institutions, and government organizations to deliver language and professional qualification
programs that accelerate workforce readiness. In Germany, for example, we focus strongly on
the healthcare sector, supporting international nurses and doctors through language training
and exam preparation to ensure their successful integration into the labor market. With
credible ambitions to expand into other professions and geographies, Lingoda is becoming a
trusted partner for organizations aiming to build skilled, future-ready workforces.
Learning a language with Lingoda is a rewarding experience, made possible by us Lingodies
who support our students every step of the way. We’re committed to living the learning
journey alongside them to create a world of connection and opportunity.
Why Join Us?
Joining Lingoda means becoming part of a team that's committed to getting better, together.
We foster and inclusive culture of bravery, curiosity and growth, where insight turns into
actions, and every team member contributes to igniting positive change
Be part of our journey to transform lives through Education!

 We are seeking a Head of FP&A (all genders) preferably based in Berlin, but open to working
remotely in Germany with regular visits to the Berlin office (up to bi-weekly visits).
Your mission with us:
As Head / VP of FP&A, you will play a pivotal role in shaping Lingoda’s financial strategy and
performance. You will lead financial planning, forecasting, and controlling, while partnering
closely with the CFO and C-suite to drive profitable growth and operational excellence.
You will establish a best-in-class FP&A function that is aligned with Lingoda’s current size and
maturity, and bring it to the next level to support the company’s ambitious growth trajectory.
At the same time, you will establish and lead a high-performance team of analysts and
controllers, empowering them to deliver excellence and impact at scale.
Beyond operational rigor, you will act as a strategic partner across the business, ensuring that
financial insights translate into clear actions and measurable results. You will also bring the
hunger to drive automation, building scalable processes and systems that increase efficiency,
accuracy, and impact.
This role is ideal for an experienced leader with the vision to define and execute a strategic
roadmap for Lingoda’s FP&A function, combined with the grit to dive deep into complex
challenges and continuously raise the bar.

Your tasks:
Strategic FP&A Leadership
Lead financial steering and ensure PE-grade standards in planning and reporting.

decisions.
Overhaul Lingoda’s financial model to create the foundation for automation.
Implement new FP&A tool enabling scalable, data-driven decision making.
Partner with CFO and senior leadership to shape financial strategy and align with
business goals.
Deliver investor-grade KPI dashboards and financial reports.

 Ensure rigorous cash flow forecasting and capital allocation to support growth.
Partner with the Chief Strategy Officer for M&A transactions.
Drive company-wide initiatives to optimize both revenue and cost, ensuring their
effective implementation to further improve profitability.
Prepare board materials and investor updates, providing transparency and strategic
insights.
Team Leadership & Cross-Functional Partnering
Lead and inspire a high-performing FP&A team, fostering trust, empowerment, and
collaboration.
Collaborate closely with Accounting, Data, and Strategy leadership to ensure financial
alignment.
Act as a strategic finance business partner across all levels of the organization, becoming
a trusted and accepted voice in key decisions.
Translate financial insights into commercial and operational strategies to drive
performance.
Lead the transformation of FP&A into a modern, automation-driven, and scalable
function.

You bring to Lingoda
10+ years of FP&A or finance leadership experience in high-growth environments, ideally
with SaaS exposure.
Proven track record in VC/PE-backed companies, with deep understanding of investor
expectations and value creation.
Significant leadership experience with the ability to simplify complex financial systems
and drive clarity at scale.
Expert knowledge of financial modeling, forecasting, and business analysis, with the
intellectual curiosity and grit to dive deep into complex topics.
Strong experience in driving automation and digitization in finance.
Advanced proficiency with modern FP&A tools (e.g. Abacum, Cube etc) as well as Google
Sheets / Excel.
Fluent in English; German is a plus
A people-centered leader who leads with empathy, inspires high-performing teams, and
partners effectively at C-suite and board level.
Exceptional communication and stakeholder management skills, with a business-savvy,
solution-oriented mindset.

About the job
Head of Finance | SaaS
Location | Vienna (willing to relocate)
For our client, a fast-growing B2B SaaS scale-up with double-digit million revenues,
we are looking for a Head of Finance. This is a unique opportunity to join a dynamic,
high-growth environment and shape the financial strategy of a market-leading SaaS
company.
The Role
As Head of Finance (m/f/d), you will take full ownership of the company's finance
function and play a crucial role in driving growth. You will report directly to the CEO
and work closely with investors, the leadership team, and operational departments.
This is a strategic role with a clear path to CFO.
Your mission is to turn financial and operational data into actionable insights, ensure
robust reporting, and implement scalable finance processes that support decision-
making and sustainable growth.
Key Responsibilities
Leadership
. Build and lead a high-performing finance team
· Foster a culture of trust, performance, and collaboration
Financial Planning & Analysis
· Own budgeting, forecasting, and variance analyses
· Develop SaaS-specific metrics and KPIs (ARR, MRR, CAC, LTV)
· Build scenario analyses and integrate insights into strategic planning
Accounting & Reporting
· Oversee accounting, cash flow management, and investor reporting
· Ensure compliance with revenue recognition rules for subscription businesses
· Implement or optimize ERP and reporting systems
Business Partnering & Strategy
· Collaborate closely with CEO, leadership, and investors
· Prepare business cases for projects, investments, and market opportunities
. Link financial results with operational and commercial drivers
· Act as a strategic partner in scaling the business
Your Profile
. 5-10+ years of progressive finance experience, ideally in fast-growing SaaS
or subscription businesses
· Deep expertise in SaaS metrics, FP&A, and financial modelling
. Experience working with investors, boards, or fundraising processes
· Hands-on, operationally minded, able to implement scalable processes
. Excellent communication skills; fluent in English (German is a plus)
· Strategic thinker with the ability to balance detailed financial work with big-
picture growth objectives
· Willingness to be based in Vienna or relocate

Senior Global Controller

FinanceFull-time

Elsbethen, Austria
Apply Now

Are you passionate about creating robust financial analyses and developing cross-functional
processes? Do you excel at stakeholder management and big-picture thinking?

At Red Bull, we operate across more than 150 dynamic markets and have unstoppable growth
ambitions. Therefore, we need to expand and reconfigure our supply chain proactively to guarantee
operational efficiency and effectiveness. We need to consider changing external environments, as
well as all cost elements of the supply chain and maintain a long-term perspective. We do all of this
to ensure our product is always available, in the right place at the right time, for the right cost.

Sound interesting? If so, you might be the Senior Operations Controller we are looking for!
RESPONSIBILITIES

Areas that play to your strengths
All the responsibilities we'll trust you with:
· In this role, you will provide financial support to the HQ Operations team, with a
particular focus on the Supply Chain Network Design team. You will be responsible for
identifying, sourcing, and delivering relevant cost data to inform strategic decisionmaking. Collaborating closely with Supply Chain Modellers and Data Scientists, you
will ensure that the digital twin of the supply chain accurately represents real-world
operations. Additionally, you will validate the outputs of this modelling and work

alongside senior leadership to develop well-informed recommendations. Once network
changes are approved, you will monitor their execution and report on performance
against the original business case.

· You will develop and refine financial processes that are effective, scalable, and
sustainable. With a keen attention to detail, you will balance priorities while assessing
financial risks, ensuring that processes evolve in alignment with business needs. Given
that these processes are at different stages of maturity, you will continuously seek
feedback to drive improvements while being mindful of their impact on local teams and
broader stakeholders. You will also recognize when innovation is necessary and when

stability is required, playing a key role in fostering efficiency and long-term success.
· Engaging with stakeholders across all levels of the organization will be a key part of
your role. You will confidently communicate with teams both within and outside of

 Finance, adapting your style to suit different audiences. Your ability to communicate
clearly and effectively in a fast-paced environment will be essential in ensuring

alignment and informed decision-making.

· You will build strong relationships across teams to support integrated decision-making
and financial planning. Through active participation in cross-functional projects, you
will contribute to organizational goals by driving synergies and shared learning across
teams. Your ability to work collaboratively will be instrumental in fostering a cohesive
and aligned approach to business strategy.

· Your passion for analytics will be a valuable asset to the team. You will leverage
advanced analytical tools and techniques to support data-driven decision-making,
identifying opportunities for innovation and efficiency improvements. Your expertise

will help shape the future of financial planning and operational strategy within the

business.
SI202209290072
SI202107060311
EXPERIENCE

Your areas of knowledge and expertise
that matter most for this role:

A minimum of five years of experience in financial controlling or a broader finance

function, with a strong understanding of financial statements and financial risk
management.

A university degree in a relevant discipline. An advanced degree or professional
certification in Finance (e.g. CPA, CMA) is highly advantageous.
Excellent knowledge of English, German is a plus.
Proficiency in financial analysis and database tools, including Microsoft Excel,
Power Query, SQL, and Tableau.
Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with a focus on financial optimization

and cost management.

Proven ability to work independently and efficiently in a fast-paced environment
while managing responsibilities effectively.
Demonstrated experience in successfully collaborating with cross-functional teams
and delivering complex projects.
Excellent communication skills, with the ability to build strong relationships across
the organization.
Exceptional attention to detail and a proactive approach to process improvement and

risk management.
Travel 0-10%
JOIN THE TEAM

Got what it takes?

 In your application we want to see your personal style - what makes you tick and why you think
your next opportunity is here with us.

Apply Now

agreement for this position, which is € 2,471 gross per month. However, our attractive
compensation package is based on market-oriented salaries and is therefore significantly above the
stated minimum salary. As an employer, we value diversity and support people in developing their
potential and strengths, realizing their ideas and seizing opportunities. We believe passionately that
employing a diverse workforce is central to our success. We welcome applications from all

jdText:
Senior FP&A & Governance Manager
About The Job

We are seeking an experienced Senior FP&A & Governance Manager professional with a proven
track record in multinational companies. The ideal candidate will have expertise in Financial and
Business Planning and Reporting, Contract Management, Internal Controls (DanGo) and
Stakeholders Management. The successful candidate will be an effective communicator, diligent
and detail-oriented, self-starting with exceptional analytical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
About the Job

These are the key responsibilities:
· Design forecasting and reporting processes, lead quarterly forecasting and monthly

closing with focus on margin control, collaboration with Business controllers and DBS
functions

· Participation in Contract validation cycle, oversee financial impacts for C&P

organization (payment terms, off-balance sheet commitments, IFRS 16), support
category buyers, legal team and operational excellence team with financial aspects

· Participate in digital transformation by co-leading contract, finance and purchasing

tools implementation and improvement (Zycus, AI, PowerBI), initiate process

optimization and digitalization projects within DanTrade finance scope
· Ensure proper Control environment, execute Finance DanGo controls, collaboration
with Internal Control team, Internal and External Auditors

Meet your future manager! Your manager will be Vladislav STRAKHOV, Finance Director
Dantrade.

About You

To be successful in this role, you meet the following qualifications:
· Expertise in financial and business planning, business development
· Good knowledge and expertise in IFRS, SoX
· Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities
· Experience in process improvement and simplification
· Advanced in Power BI and other BI tools to build dashboards for data analysis and
reporting

· Proven experience as a Finance Business Partner in a multinational company

· Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills
About Us

Working at Danone is a unique experience. It's fast-paced and complex and, at times, it can get a
little challenging. But it's packed with opportunities to learn and grow working with some of the
best-known brands in the world, like Evian, Alpro, Nutricia, Activia and Nutrilon. Bring your
unique perspective, ambitions and entrepreneurial ideas to the table - the impact you could make
might just surprise you. One Planet. One Health - BY YOU.

 We're proud to be a B-Corp certified company. That means we meet the highest verified standards
of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability in everything we do.
We're committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. As an Equal Opportunities Employer, we

base our hiring decisions on merit, job requirements and business needs .*
We Offer

It's an exciting time to join Danone as a Senior FP&A Governance Manager. You'll build
meaningful relationships and networks working with large, dynamic brands. And the best part?
You'll be supported to grow an impactful career that you can be proud of. Together, we'll build a
healthier world.

All Danoners receive a complete package of benefits. This includes a competitive salary and yearly
bonus, a premium free pension and great discounts on health insurance and Danone products. We
understand the importance of flexibility and offer 30 days of annual leave (with the opportunity to
purchase more) and a hybrid working environment, where you can work either from home or from
one of our People Hubs in Hoofddorp, Utrecht and Rijswijk.

What's Next

It's simple - hit the "apply" button before the application deadline of October 10th. Please note
that if we receive a high volume of applications, we may close the job posting earlier than the stated
deadline. In order to comply with GDPR we can't process your personal data without your given

consent, so please apply directly via this website. Good luck! We can't wait to meet you.
Need more information? Please contact Claudia Llona, Talent Acquisition Manager via
claudia.llona@danone.com.

* All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, colour, religion, sex,

sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status

About the role

As VP Finance & Accounting, you will own the company’s financial operations, KP! reporting, and
investor transparency during our current scale-up phase. This role goes beyond traditional finance
and tax responsibilities - it is about helping measure, steer, and control the business.

You will ensure excellence in accounting, financial control, and regulatory compliance while acting
as a hands-on strategic finance partner to the CEO, leadership team, and investors. In this capacity,
you will build and scale a robust finance function that supports operational decision-making and
prepares the company for its next growth milestones.

The preferred location for this role is Austria, with office locations in Innsbruck and Vienna, with
flexibility for hybrid work.

What you'll do

Act as a Strategic Finance Partner to the Business:
e Serve as a trusted partner to the CEO and leadership team, supporting budgeting, forecasting,
and long-term financial planning to inform strategic decision-making.
e Provide financial insights that guide key business and operational initiatives.

e Ensure accurate, timely, and compliant financial reporting while maintaining full audit
readiness.

*® Optimize cash flow management and oversee treasury activities, including working capital and
funding requirements.

e Build and implement scalable finance processes and systems to support the company's
growth.

* Collaborate cross-functionally to embed financial best practices across the organization.
* Support pricing strategy, growth initiatives, and key commercial decisions.

e Lead, mentor, and develop the finance team while fostering a high-performance and
collaborative culture.
 
Scale Finance Operations with the Business:
*® Own the full accounting cycle across multiple legal entities, including AP/AR, general ledger,
fixed assets, accruals, and deferrals, ensuring accurate and timely monthly closes.

e Lead statutory and management reporting under IFRS, UGB, and US GAAP, ensuring
compliance and audit readiness.

e Maintain a robust internal control environment to support clean balance sheets and regulatory
compliance.

* Oversee group accounting, intercompany processes, and multi-currency operations.

e Identify and implement automation opportunities to streamline financial workflows and
improve operational efficiency.

* Continuously develop scalable finance processes to support growth, onboarding, and
standardization.
Connect the Company with its Investors:
* Own investor and board reporting, including financial and operational KPIs, forecasts, and
performance narratives.

e Deliver clear and consistent updates on financial performance, company strategy, and market
outlook.

e Ensure accuracy, clarity, and timeliness of all investor communications.
e Align investor expectations with the company’s financial performance and strategic direction.

e Support ad-hoc investor requests while maintaining transparency, credibility, and trust.

We are looking for someone with

e Extensive experience in finance, accounting, or scale-up finance experience, including several
years in a leadership role (Director level).

e Experience in SaaS, scale-ups, or other fast-paced environments, where you had the
opportunity to build and shape parts of the finance function.

* The ability to cultivate talent, foster growth, and build high-performing teams.

e Astrong background in FP&A, accounting, and financial operations, as well as building out
reporting and business intelligence systems.

* Strategic thinking combined with a hands-on approach, and being comfortable switching
between big-picture strategy and detailed execution.

e Experience in international finance, multi-entity accounting, and compliance.

e Excellent communication skills and the ability to act as a strong partner to cross-functional
stakeholders with clarity and impact.

e Experience building and maintaining a modern and efficient finance tech stack, with a strong
focus on automation and data integrity.

That said, we'd be particularly delighted to hire someone with

e Passion about technology, innovation, and building sustainable business practices.
e An interest in the coffee industry and the specialty coffee market.

What you can expect
 
The compensation package for this position consists of a base salary starting at € 120K
gross/year* and a bonus on top - we look at factors like your experience and individual
qualifications to determine our offer. Additional benefits include budgets for education &
wellbeing, and professional development, remote work and home office, very flexible working
hours without core hours, paid time for volunteer work, access to mental health support, tax-
friendly bike leasing, and an endless stream of really great coffee. We also make our best possible
offer upfront - no games.

*This represents our anticipated salary for 2026, which is still under review. Final details will be discussed and

confirmed during the interview process.

Apply now

We look forward to receiving your application! If you have any questions, don't hesitate to contact
our team at jobs@cropster.com.

About us

Cropster is the market-leading Software as a Service solution to drive quality, productivity, and
sustainability excellence across the coffee value chain. We're helping businesses focus on core
processes related to quality, consistency, planning, traceability, and resource management at every
stage of coffee production.

We believe affordable technology can be used by everyone to increase fairness for all players in the
market, resulting in a better cup of coffee for consumers. As a Certified B Corporation™, we're also
committed to working towards being an even better company that benefits all people,
communities, and the planet.

jdText:
Global Director Finance & Operations
(m/f/d)
What we do at PlanRadar
PlanRadar is a leading platform for digital documentation, communication and reporting
in construction, facility management and real estate projects. It enables customers to work
more efficiently, enhance quality and achieve full project transparency. By improving
collaboration and providing access to real-time data, PlanRadar’s easy-to-use platform
adds value to every person involved in a building’s lifecycle, with flexible capabilities for all
company sizes and processes. Today, PlanRadar serves more than 150,000 users across
75+ countries.
PlanRadar promises an inclusive, engaging and exciting place to work. We are inquisitive
minds who challenge the status quo, with a drive to change our client's industry for the
better. Our people matter the most, and we regularly conduct surveys and implement
changes to ensure our benefits and the way we work reflects the culture that we promote.
If you're courageous and ready for a new adventure, join PlanRadar!
Meet the team here!
What you’ll get to do
As Global Director Finance & Operations, you will lead and continuously develop
PlanRadar’s global Finance & Operations organization in a fast-growing SaaS environment.
You will be responsible for building scalable structures, strengthening processes and
enabling sustainable growth across multiple regions and legal entities.
AMONG OTHER THINGS YOU WILL
Lead and develop the global Finance & Operations organization, covering
Finance, Controlling, Legal and Operations (including Business Operations and
System Operations) across multiple international regions and legal entities
Build, evolve and continuously improve financial and operational core processes,
including Quote-to-Cash, Procure-to-Pay and Lead-to-Close, together with your
teams
Drive high-quality financial planning, budgeting, forecasting and reporting,
ensuring transparency, accuracy and timely decision-making across the
organization
Partner closely with Go-To-Market teams to translate growth targets into
scalable financial, operational and system processes
Build and continuously evolve forecasting, pipeline, commission and incentive
models to support predictable and sustainable revenue growth
Drive operational excellence, data quality and system reliability across reporting,
KPIs, CRM and core business tools
Oversee legal, regulatory and compliance topics in close collaboration with
internal and external stakeholders
Act as a strategic sparring partner to the CEO and Management Team, providing
financial and operational insights to support long-term strategy and company
growth
WHO YOU ARE
You bring 8–10+ years of experience in Finance & Accounting and 5–7+ years in
Business Operations, gained within an international environment
You have proven leadership experience in senior or director-level roles, including
leading and developing senior leaders
You bring a strong understanding of B2B SaaS business models and experience
working in venture-backed, high-growth environments
You combine strategic thinking with a hands-on, execution-focused mindset and
enjoy building and improving structures together with your teams
You demonstrate strong analytical capabilities, with experience working with
KPIs, BI tools and complex data sets
You are a confident communicator and trusted advisor to senior stakeholders
across the organization
You have excellent spoken and written business English skills; German is a strong
advantage
What we offer
Room for personal and professional development
Challenging and diversified line of action
Working in a fast-growing company with international customers and investors
Centrally located and attractive office in Vienna
Possibilities to work from home
Motivated and agile team with a common vision
Additional benefits like team events, free drinks & snacks, …
The annual gross minimum salary according to the collective agreement based on the
Austrian law for this position is minimum EUR 82.600. This includes: full health insurance,
occupational accident insurance, public pension scheme and public unemployment
insurance. Depending on your individual professional qualifications and previous
experience your salary could be significantly higher.

To strengthen our motivated Group Strategy & Transformation Team in Vienna, we are looking

As Senior Transformation Manager, you lead international transformation/improvement
projects across all Divisions and functions of MM Group
Examples for such projects are: Re-organization, restructuring, integration of
acquisitions, commercial and operational excellence - for individual sites or entire
Divisions
You are the project manager for these projects - depending on the type of project, you
run analyses, conduct interviews and workshops, develop recommendations and action

Current focus is on a company-wide transformation project which requires support on a

take over the Head of Department role after some time

You have a completed University degree in Business Administration, Engineering or
similar
You gained at least 5 years professional experience, ideally from management
consulting (at least Senior Project Manager level) or from similar role in the industry
(corporate development, corporate strategy etc.)
You bring ideally experience across a number of functional topics (e.g. operations,
supply chain, restructuring, sales) and in industries similar to ours
You have strong analytical and communication skills, a solid understanding of business,
a hands-on mentality, and an action-oriented approach
You work independently, in a well-structured, precise, and diligent manner

We offer you a workplace in a stable, international company with long-term growth path. You
can also look forward to interesting tasks with a high degree of management scope in a team

Academy and the possibility to work from home one day a week.

Sports events and activities

roadmap.
Development of Business Unit and Sub-Business Unit strategies to drive profitable growth.
Ownership of strategic planning, execution, and controlling, including KPI-based
steering, performance tracking, and decision support for top management.

Close coordination of strategic topics with Corporate Development / Strategy of the

Board and Supervisory Board reporting: structuring, analysis, storylining, and
presentation.
Scenario analyses, market and financial modeling.
Preparation and management of strategic transformation programs (e.g. operating
model changes).
Support of organizational development initiatives.
Build-up and leadership of a Market Intelligence function.
Strategic M&A and JV activities: screening, valuation, strategic analyses, and integration
concepts.

University degree in Business Administration, Engineering, Natural Sciences, or a
comparable field.

highly desirable.

Deep understanding of strategy development (preferably in an M&A context), strategic

Strong analytical capabilities combined with excellent storytelling skills.
Ability to independently develop strategies together with BU/SBU leaders and General

High communication skills and assertiveness.
